shared_elements: row/register of figures in low relief
figures in long robes facing one direction
repeated near-identical figures in a procession
justification: Both surfaces carry a horizontal register of closely spaced, similarly sized standing human figures shown in strict profile in low relief, effectively a procession of repeated robed figures moving in one direction, which is a real but widely shared convention. The biggest differences in content are A's winged sun-disc surmounting the scene, its confronted offering pairs with divine attributes, and its extensive registers of script, none of which appear in B, whose frieze is set into an architectural stair wall flanked by columns.
